name: 33012 · Hialeah, FL
findings: ZIP 33012 (Hialeah) has 79 nonprofit organizations. 19 of them (24%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 16 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33012 (Hialeah) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
32% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 33012 (Hialeah) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 22% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 18 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
